usedFor: api.video hosts videos and live streams, and Brevo holds contacts, so “Live Stream Ended” can feed “Add Contacts To List”.

bestTemplate.name: “Live Stream Ended” in api.video, then “Add Contacts To List” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: A stream ending is the moment to move its contacts onto a follow-up list.

watchOut: “Add Contacts To List” only adds contacts that already exist in Brevo, matched by email, contact ID or external ID.
